name: biome
readme:
# Biome

Linting and formatting for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, CSS and more, from the `@biomejs/biome` package of your project. The extension has no binary of its own: install the package in the project, otherwise it stays quiet.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

works: Diagnostics while typing and on save, with or without a biome.json
Format Document, Format Selection and format on type
Quick fixes and suppressions, source.fixAll.biome and source.organizeImports.biome on save
biome.restart, and a changed biome.json is picked up
limits: Choose Biome over another formatter with the editor.defaultFormatter setting: Diode has no Format Document With picker, and without the setting the first formatter runs instead of asking
